data.body: Additional observation: the Phase A gate in skills/sprint/SKILL.md is malformed. It captures the script with `2>&1` then tests `[[ -z "$DRAFT_PR_URL" ]]`. On script failure the stderr error message lands in DRAFT_PR_URL, making the variable non-empty and the `-z` test false — the gate spuriously passes with DRAFT_PR_URL set to the error string. To actually halt, the gate should either capture exit code (`bash ... ; rc=$?`) or pattern-match the URL prefix (e.g. `[[ "$DRAFT_PR_URL" != https://* ]]`). Fix should address both: (a) script bootstrap chicken-and-egg, and (b) gate that fails to detect the failure.
